summary: Server only. A deck of pieces players hold in their hands at a Tabletop, made with table.createDeck: playing cards by default, or your own pieces (tiles, tarot, a game's cards). It lies face down as a stack on the table; dealt pieces fly into the seated players' left hands, held as a fan whose faces only the holder's game gets, and played pieces are thrown with the right hand onto piles. The holder works their hand with keys (see Docs: Tabletop games), and every step of theirs is an event you can refuse, so the rules of your game are yours.

pieces.summary: Every piece of the deck, wherever it is: in the stack, a hand, on a pile or in the air.
pieces.exampleLua:
local aces = {}
for _, piece in ipairs(deck.pieces) do
  if piece.rank == "A" then
    table.insert(aces, piece)
  end
end

remaining.summary: How many pieces are left in the stack.

piles.summary: The names of its piles on the table: 'table' (where played pieces land, unless createDeck's playPile names another) and those addPile made.

exists.summary: False once the deck or its table is gone.

deal.summary: Deals `count` pieces (1 by default) from the top of the stack to a player or to each of a list, one round after another as a dealer does: each flies from the stack into the player's hand, a moment after the one before. The pieces are in the hands when they land; it answers them at once. Fewer when the stack runs out. Drawing one piece is deal(player).

params.players: A Player, or a list of them.
params.count: Optional: how many each, 1 by default.

dealTo.summary: Deals `count` pieces from the stack onto a pile: `faceUp` (the pile's own by default) shows their faces. A poker flop, the first card of Prší face up.
dealTo.example:
deck.addPile('board', { position: { x: 0, y: 0.1 }, layout: 'row' });
deck.dealTo('board', 3);
dealTo.exampleLua:
deck:addPile("board", { position = { x = 0, y = 0.1 }, layout = "row" })
deck:dealTo("board", 3)
dealTo.exampleCs:
deck.AddPile("board", new { position = new { x = 0, y = 0.1 }, layout = "row" });
deck.DealTo("board", 3);

hand.summary: The pieces a player holds, in the fan's order from left to right.

selected.summary: The pieces of a player's hand they have selected (raised out of the fan) to play together.

select.summary: Selects a piece of a hand, or lets it back into the fan with false; throws for a piece in nobody's hand.

play.summary: The player throws pieces of their hand onto a pile (the play pile by default): their right hand takes each from the fan, swings over the table and lets go, and it flies on and lands, face up unless the pile or `faceUp` says otherwise. The promise settles true when they all lie there. The holder's own play key does this after deckPlayRequest; call it yourself for a play your script decides.

params.pieces: A piece or a list of pieces of their hand.

addPile.summary: Adds a pile, or changes one: `position` { x, y } metres from the table's middle on its own axes, `faceUp` (true by default), `layout` 'stack' (each piece on the one before, a little turned) or 'row' (side by side, `spacing` metres apart) and `rotation` degrees. At most 24 piles.

params.name: The pile's name: 1 to 32 letters, digits, _ or -.
params.options: Optional: { position, faceUp, layout, spacing, rotation }.

addPile.example: deck.addPile('discard', { position: { x: 0.15, y: 0 }, faceUp: true });
addPile.exampleLua: deck:addPile("discard", { position = { x = 0.15, y = 0 }, faceUp = true })
addPile.exampleCs: deck.AddPile("discard", new { position = new { x = 0.15, y = 0 }, faceUp = true });

pile.summary: The pieces on a pile, bottom first: its last is the top one.
pile.exampleLua:
local pile = deck:pile("table")
local top = pile[#pile]

move.summary: Moves any piece onto a pile: from the stack, another pile or a hand, without a throw. It flies there; `faceUp` (the pile's own by default). The promise settles true when it lies there.

flip.summary: Turns a piece on a pile over, or face up or down as `faceUp` says.

params.faceUp: Optional: true or false; turned over when left out.

reveal.summary: Shows a player's hand to everyone (a showdown): their fan's faces reach every game until conceal.

conceal.summary: Shows a revealed hand's faces to its holder only again.

cover.summary: Lays a player's hand face down on the table before them, their left hand resting on it, as a player does who waits; false when they hold nothing or already covered it. The holder's cover key does this after deckCover.

uncover.summary: Takes a covered hand up again; false when it was not covered.

covered.summary: Whether a player's hand lies covered on the table.

collect.summary: Every piece back into the stack, face down: the hands and the piles fly back. The promise settles when they are there (false when the deck went meanwhile). Shuffle and deal again for the next round.

restock.summary: Turns a pile into the stack again when the stack runs out, as Prší does: its pieces fly back face down, but its top `keep` (1 by default), and the stack is shuffled (unless `shuffle` is false). The promise settles with how many went back.

setActions.summary: Names the holder's draw, pass and look keys, the game's own key hints while they sit at the table: `draw` (E) asks for a piece from the stack (deckDrawRequest), `pass` (Space) passes, checks or stands (deckPass), `look` (holding E) steps through the close looks at the hand and the table, as C does. Each is a text of up to 48 characters, or false for no such key. With a player, only theirs (whose turn it is, say), until the deck's are set again. At first there are 'Pass' and 'Look closer' keys and no draw key.

params.actions: { draw, pass, look }: any of them.

setActions.example:
deck.setActions({ draw: 'Draw a card', pass: 'Stand' });
deck.setActions({ pass: 'Check' }, player);
setActions.exampleLua:
deck:setActions({ draw = "Draw a card", pass = "Stand" })
deck:setActions({ pass = "Check" }, player)
setActions.exampleCs:
deck.SetActions(new { draw = "Draw a card", pass = "Stand" });
deck.SetActions(new { pass = "Check" }, player);

actions.summary: The labels of the draw, pass and look keys a player has (the deck's own without a player): { draw, pass, look }, each a text or false.

save.summary: The deck as a plain object to keep (with SharedState or a file): the stack's order, the hands with their order and the piles; each piece's data too.

load.summary: Lays a saved deck out again: the stack, the piles, and the hands of the players still seated (the others' pieces go to the stack's bottom).

destroy.summary: Removes the deck: its pieces leave the hands and the table, and the holders' hands go down.
